Generally I’m quite positive in the direction of these changes, will need to see how it is implemented at this point to understand it. Gnosis change seems great since you aren’t spamming them and it doesn’t feel as bad if you just gnosis once on w5 for example.

I agree with the direction of the changes this time around, however, I think more than in any other of the previous announcements, this version relies on the numbers being tuned well.

If the HP and enemy damage numbers aren't unreasonable, it could be the best version of the changes yet, the middle ground we've been working towards as a community.

But if they aren't tuned well, then many of the problems brought up when the original announcement was made will feel just as bad, if not a little worse.

So it highly depends on balancing and number-tuning this time around.

I noticed that Light was very careful to avoid giving a numbers estimate for the new difficulties this time around. Perhaps he is now afraid of potential backlash over the huge numbers creep they intended to implement, like what happened during the first iteration when he carelessly revealed that enemy hp would increase up to 9 fold. Whether this current iteration is good or not depends solely on the numbers. I will say this again: Uninspiring numbers inflation is the worst way possible to go about doing this, if it goes out of control it wouldn't be pretty. I hope the devs would not believe that the numbers need inflating just because all the AA whales dominate the top of the leaderboard making it seem easy, the highest difficulty should be clearable by lower spenders with reasonable investment and intelligence (e3 lv80, for example). Light refused to even provide a demonstration that the devs themselves can clear highest difficulty without high dupe units in the other post. I hope the dev team would treat this issue with the prudence it deserves.

I would at least like to set default covenants in the awakener screen, that way I can see how the covenant affects their stats in the same menu I do the rest of character progression and review in. Plus it's less time grabbing the same 6 triangles from the sea of triangles every time I setup a team or make a swap. Sometimes the triangles will need to change depending on the line up, but having defaults will save me time in the menu so I can play more.

If I could fuse 6 triangles into a super triangle that would be great as well, that way I can build a stat and share it between awakeners more easily 

I am in favor of gear changes that make it easier to manage equipment.

my 2nd feedback this time

For dtide 
1) The new system favours vertically invested teams instead of horizontal invested teams. Since points increase by 10 each difficulty, while doing an extra clear on the same difficulty gives only 5 points. 

What does this mean? This causes less team building variety and encourages pulling for absolute axiom AA to make a single team clear the highest difficulty for the most points. 

Who does this affect? Mostly free to play / low spender players that have a wide roster of low invested e0~e3 units. This is basically the majority of the player base. 

My thoughts is to rework the point system that balances both vertical & horizontal investment. Much like the current dtide 10x alert 4 = 5x alert 5 = 400 points

2)The new nightmare / madness difficulties seemingly only have their hp increase 2-3x and damage 30-60% each tier. 

What does this mean? This either translate to 1 or 2 things. Either, existing units have to be buffed in order to make them viable against this difficulty and future releasing units will have increasing higher power floor / ceilings. If that is not the case, this means pulling for OE/AA becomes an ever increasing demand just to play higher level difficulties in dtide. 

Who does this affect? Majority of the player base who are not whales / big spenders. 

My thoughts are if BIAV cares about powercreep and truly believes in what they said about “OE/AA being not needed in content”, explore different ways to increase dtide difficulty instead of blinding increasing hp & damage. 

Allowing skill expression is satisfying thing in morimens and should be prioritise instead of wallet flexing. 

I hope biav looks into this seriously as this is likely the biggest factor that can improve or worsen the game’s power creep, monetisation, and balance.

I think covenant bonding is a great and cheap way to empower a set of covenant, and would benefit new and old players alike. It would be a good change as long as new content are not heavily balanced around bonded covenants.
